description: Teradyne, Inc., founded in 1960, is a leading global provider of automated test equipment and robotics solutions, whose automated test systems are used to test semiconductors, wireless products, data storage, silicon photonics and complex electronics systems in many industries including consumer electronics, wireless, automotive, industrial, computing, communications, and aerospace and defense industries, and whose robotics product offerings consist primarily of collaborative robotic arms and autonomous mobile robots used by global manufacturing, logistics and industrial customers to improve quality, increase manufacturing and material handling efficiency while reducing costs. In the first quarter of 2025 it identified opportunities for operational synergies amongst its production board test, defense and aerospace, and wireless test businesses leading to the creation of the Product Test division as a new segment effective March 2025, and its FLEX Test Platform architecture advances its core technologies to produce test equipment designed for high efficiency multi-site testing.
